scope: Worker stability, persistent restart diagnostics, check/search overhead, and interruption/report bookkeeping. Qualification uses disposable databases/workspaces and scripted model events only; no paid provider jobs or production run/history writes.
causality_limit: The historical worker exit trigger was not retained. The SQLite status-publication fatal exit and stop-poll run failure were reproduced independently; neither is asserted to be the historical trigger.
qualified_fixes: Busy/locked worker status publication retries on the next loop without replacing its runtime; other errors and obsolete identity still fail closed.
Stop polling pauses at the execution gate during contention, rechecks ownership after recovery, and conservatively stops after a bounded outage. It never replays a model/tool effect.
One atomic SQL heartbeat renews live execution claims and their worker lease; expired claims, deadlines and owners are not revived. Expired worker ownership triggers restart/reconciliation.
Cleanup is attempted independently of final status publication.
Worker Python exceptions, lifetime events, native faults and supervisor exit codes/signals are persisted in bounded, private diagnostics. Only a bounded SQL snapshot reaches the API.
Library search defaults to inventory/evidence discovery without compiling returned sibling drafts; unverified entries remain non-reusable.

Dependency resolution caches the import/module/prelude header with configuration; proof-only changes reuse resolution. Preparation avoids redundant closure observations while preserving final identity checks and an uninterrupted build-to-reader lease.
Generic recoverable interruptions do not become turn caps. Recovery details and explicit reasons are preserved; generic bridge interruption is not mislabeled as a user stop.
Report acceptance/synthesis state is persisted; a failed background persistence promise is observed without an unhandled process-level rejection.

diagnostics.boundary: API import of app.worker_diagnostics and reads of worker-diagnostics files are denied. Public transport unchanged by this patch.

assertions: Normal evidence-based needs-review result for the fixture without Lean evidence

activation.state: Source changes qualified; existing development stack not restarted by this task.
activation.required: Restart start-dev.sh once to load supervisor/worker changes. Use Re-formalize for old interrupted attempts if executable/tool checkpoint contracts no longer match. Existing drafts/history and compatibility fencing are retained.

limits: Isolated macOS ARM64 measurements are not a production latency distribution.
First-time compiler dependency discovery and selected-result inspection remain material costs.
Historical failed-batch facts/reports were not rewritten and paid formalizations were not rerun.
This follow-up does not republish/requalify production container images or relax checkpoint compatibility.
